QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] She's On A Boat 1
QuestInfo.0: The Mushking is pleased that there is a way onto the airship, but finding the princess might still be a challenge. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: There's a way onto the airship, but all the mushrooms are too scared to go. The Mushking is on the verge of tears, thinking of his poor hideo-er, lovely daughter. He wants you to rescue her, naturally.
QuestInfo.2: You boarded the Viking's airship and met James the mushroom prisoner on board.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: #questorder1#Find the device at the Castle Rear Entrance (#R30063ExRef30063#)\r\n

0.conditionContent: Find the device at the back of the Castle

0.0: I heard you handled the interrogation yourself. I can only imagine how cruel your methods were, since you won't tell me... And I won't ask. At least there is hope in rescuing Violetta.
0.1: The problem is, who will go? The mushrooms are terrified of the Vikings... Okay, look, we know it's going to be you. You'll do it, right? That's why you're here, right?

yes.0: I... I can't imagine what my precious child is going through... She is so weak and vulnerable. I will have you marr-where are you going?

no.0: Fine, this is my last resort. If you can rescue Violetta, you may marry her! In this dire situation, I am willing to offer you ANYTHING to get the job done!

0.msg: Oh, stop staring at me like that. Fine, better go rescue Violetta.

default.0: You must return with Violetta! I'll grant any wish!
